cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(ech_http LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(CMAKE_C_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
set(CMAKE_CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
set(CMAKE_VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON)
if(NOT DEFINED EH_DEPS_ROOT)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Use the Dart build hook to supply the verified dependency SDK")
endif()
include("${EH_DEPS_ROOT}/cmake/EchHttpDeps.cmake")
if(NOT EXISTS "${EH_DART_INCLUDE}/dart_native_api.h")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Use the Dart build hook to supply EH_DART_INCLUDE from the active Dart SDK")
endif()

file(READ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cacert.pem" EH_CA_PEM)
# Upstream embeds the whole CA bundle as a single C++ raw string literal
# (ca_bundle.h.in). MSVC rejects any string literal larger than 65,535 bytes
# with C2026 and the bundle is ~186 KB, so the bridge cannot compile on
# VS 2022 toolchains. Split the bundle into ~14 KB chunks joined by adjacent
# string concatenation instead; the generated header is semantically identical.
string(REPLACE "\r\n" "\n" EH_CA_PEM "${EH_CA_PEM}")
string(REPLACE "\n" ";" EH_CA_LINES "${EH_CA_PEM}")
set(EH_CA_CHUNKS "")
set(EH_CA_CURRENT "")
set(EH_CA_CURRENT_LEN 0)
foreach(EH_CA_LINE IN LISTS EH_CA_LINES)
  string(LENGTH "${EH_CA_LINE}" EH_CA_LINE_LEN)
  math(EXPR EH_CA_NEW_LEN "${EH_CA_CURRENT_LEN} + ${EH_CA_LINE_LEN} + 1")
  if(EH_CA_NEW_LEN GREATER 14000 AND EH_CA_CURRENT_LEN GREATER 0)
    list(APPEND EH_CA_CHUNKS "${EH_CA_CURRENT}")
    set(EH_CA_CURRENT "${EH_CA_LINE}\n")
    set(EH_CA_CURRENT_LEN ${EH_CA_LINE_LEN})
  else()
    string(APPEND EH_CA_CURRENT "${EH_CA_LINE}\n")
    set(EH_CA_CURRENT_LEN ${EH_CA_NEW_LEN})
  endif()
endforeach()
if(EH_CA_CURRENT_LEN GREATER 0)
  list(APPEND EH_CA_CHUNKS "${EH_CA_CURRENT}")
endif()
set(EH_CA_PARTS "")
set(EH_CA_INDEX 0)
foreach(EH_CA_CHUNK IN LISTS EH_CA_CHUNKS)
  string(APPEND EH_CA_PARTS
    "  static const char roots_part_${EH_CA_INDEX}[] = R\"ECH_CA(${EH_CA_CHUNK})ECH_CA\";\n")
  math(EXPR EH_CA_INDEX "${EH_CA_INDEX} + 1")
endforeach()
set(EH_CA_SUM "")
set(EH_CA_JOIN 0)
while(EH_CA_JOIN LESS EH_CA_INDEX)
  if(EH_CA_JOIN EQUAL 0)
    set(EH_CA_SUM "std::string(roots_part_0)")
  else()
    string(APPEND EH_CA_SUM " + roots_part_${EH_CA_JOIN}")
  endif()
  math(EXPR EH_CA_JOIN "${EH_CA_JOIN} + 1")
endwhile()
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ca_bundle.h"
"#pragma once\n#include <string>\ninline const std::string &eh_ca_bundle() {\n${EH_CA_PARTS}  static const std::string roots = ${EH_CA_SUM};\n  return roots;\n}\n")
add_library(ech_http SHARED ech_http.cpp)
# Imported includes default to -isystem, which can lose to a host OpenSSL
# installation in /usr/local/include. Always prefer this SDK's pinned headers.
set_target_properties(ech_http PROPERTIES NO_SYSTEM_FROM_IMPORTED ON)
target_include_directories(ech_http PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}" "${EH_DART_INCLUDE}")
target_link_libraries(ech_http PRIVATE EchHttp::curl)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(ech_http PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
if(ANDROID)
  target_link_options(ech_http PRIVATE "-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384" "-Wl,--exclude-libs,ALL" "-Wl,--strip-debug")
elseif(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
  target_link_options(ech_http PRIVATE "-Wl,--exclude-libs,ALL")
endif()
if(APPLE)
  set_target_properties(ech_http PROPERTIES INSTALL_NAME_DIR "@rpath" BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_NAME_DIR ON)
endif()
set_target_properties(ech_http PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/out" LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/out")
